content.title: All the MLB Baseball Games on NBC & Peacock Today & This Week (March 26-April 1)
content.text: Major League Baseball is back in action this week, and thanks to NBC Sports’ expansive new deal with the league, plenty of the biggest MLB games of the season will be on NBC and Peacock. This week? That means Opening Day, Sunday Night Baseball and even some bonus games streaming on Peacock.How to WatchWatch MLB on NBC and streaming on Peacock.The baseball action starts for NBC and Peacock on Opening Day, Thursday, March 26, with a doubleheader featuring some of the league’s biggest teams and stars. First, Paul Skenes and the Pittsburgh Pirates take on the New York Mets, followed by the reigning World Series champion Los Angeles Dodgers facing the Arizona Diamondbacks in the only primetime game airing on Opening Day.RELATED: MLB on NBC: Sunday Night Baseball & Sunday Leadoff Broadcast Team, ExplainedAfter that, baseball fans will enjoy the first pitch of NBC Sports’ Sunday Night Baseball, when the Cleveland Guardians head to Seattle to take on the Mariners in primetime live on Peacock. Along with all those marquee games, Peacock will also showcase a “Game of the Day” slate with a nationally streamed out-of-market game each day, featuring teams such as the Houston Astros hosting the Los Angeles Angels, and the Atlanta Braves hosting the Kansas City Royals for some early-season series.The road to the World Series is officially open for business.Full schedule for all the MLB games on NBC & Peacock this weekOpening Day on NBC & Peacock (Thursday, March 26)Thursday, March 26: Pirates at Mets, 1 p.m. ET - NBC & PeacockThursday, March 26: Diamondbacks at Dodgers, 8 p.m. ET - NBC & PeacockSunday Night Baseball (Season Debut)Sunday, March 29: Guardians at Mariners, 7 p.m. ET - Peacock Peacock “Game of the Day” (Streaming Exclusive)Thurs., March 26: Los Angeles Angels at Houston Astros, 4:10 p.m. ET - PeacockFri., March 27: Kansas City Royals at Atlanta Braves, 7:15 p.m. ET - PeacockSat., March 28: Tampa Bay Rays at St. Louis Cardinals, 2:15 p.m. ET - PeacockSun., March 29: Texas Rangers at Philadelphia Phillies, 1:35 p.m. ET - Peacock
